lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy2Mg12Co2 (DyMg6Co) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Co and Dy each have 12 geometric neighbors, while Mg centers also show 12 neighbors, with neighbor distances spanning roughly 2.96–3.35 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals 12-vertex Mg–Mg, Co–Mg, and Dy–Mg coordination polyhedra connected through corner-, edge-, and face-sharing patterns.
